subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: What permanent scheduling contract should the public `yieldToolResult(...)` API require when its tool appears in a multi-tool assistant batch?
rationale: A result-only signal arrives too late to stop already-started parallel siblings, so maintainers must choose whether yield capability requires existing sequential metadata, a new pre-execution capability marker, or deliberately weaker semantics.

options.title: Require sequential tools
options.body: Require tools that may return `yieldToolResult(...)` to declare `executionMode: "sequential"`, reject misuse explicitly, and test that later siblings do not start.

options.title: Add yield-capable metadata
options.body: Add a dedicated pre-execution tool capability that makes any containing batch sequential, increasing the public SDK surface but making intent explicit.

options.title: Use next-turn-only semantics
options.body: Permit parallel siblings to finish and document that result-level yield only prevents another model turn, which is weaker than existing `sessions_yield` behavior.

recommendation.title: Require sequential tools
recommendation.body: Require tools that may return `yieldToolResult(...)` to declare `executionMode: "sequential"`, reject misuse explicitly, and test that later siblings do not start.

likelyOwner.reason: They made and merged the original architectural decision that `sessions_yield` must produce a real turn-ending idle-session handoff.
